entries.summary: Do not expel those calling upon their Lord morning and evening

entries.summary: Greet believers with peace; divine mercy and repentance after wrongdoing
entries.caveat: Repentance and mercy are shared themes, but Ezekiel does not prescribe the greeting or the Qur'anic formula

entries.summary: Signs clarified and path of wrongdoers distinguished
Prophet prohibited from worshipping those invoked apart from God
entries.caveat: Shared exclusive worship command; Qur'an's first-person prophetic disclaimer differs from Sinai legal form

entries.summary: Messenger stands on clear evidence; judgment belongs to God
entries.caveat: General prophetic authority and divine judgment; no source-specific predecessor established

entries.summary: If threatened punishment were in messenger's possession, dispute would end

entries.summary: Keys of unseen with God; falling leaf and seed known to God

entries.summary: God takes souls by night and raises them by day until appointed term
entries.caveat: Sleep and waking under divine care are thematic; the Qur'anic soul-taking and appointed-term formulation is distinct
